data.title: Engro Corp eyes tower sharing expansion with Veon tie-up:
data.description: Pakistan’s largest conglomerate Engro Corp, through its strategic partnership with Veon, is eyeing expanding telecom tower-sharing coverage in Pakistan and exploring different use cases in telecom infrastructure.

data.title: Engro looking to go global, says Samad Dawood
data.description: Pakistan’s largest conglomerate, Engro Corp, is looking to expand into new markets, including the Middle East, Central Asia and Africa, the chemicals-to-energy company’s largest investor said.

data.title: Engro Elengy seeks SIFC intervention to expand LNG terminal
data.description: Engro Elengy Terminal Limited, a joint venture between Engro Corporation and Royal Vopak, has asked the Special Investment Facilitation Council to help resolve the issues with Sui Southern Gas Company over expanding its liquefied natural gas (LNG) import terminal.
